operations.description: Sends the current login, registration, or password-recovery challenge through the dependency-owned Messaging App SDK. The runtime adapter maps IAM scene and verification type fields to sceneCode and channel and retains only the bounded, expiring codeId correlation required for a later verification call.
Verifies the submitted code against the dependency-owned Messaging challenge identified by the bounded runtime correlation cache; raw codes are never retained in client state.
